Install omareel on Omarchy

Screen recorder and editor for Omarchy with a synthetic cursor, auto zooms, and a camera bubble

  1. Open a terminal.
  2. Run the install command:
    omarchy pkg add omareel
  3. Check it landed. Pacman should list version 0.3.0-2:
    pacman -Qi omareel

Open and use omareel

To see what the package installed, including any commands and desktop entries:

pacman -Ql omareel

Frequently asked questions

How do I install omareel on Omarchy?

Open a terminal and run omarchy pkg add omareel. The download is 1.4 MB and it takes 3.9 MB once installed. Omarchy pulls in any dependencies automatically.

Is omareel free?

Check the project site for current pricing. The package is licensed MIT.

How do I uninstall omareel?

Run omarchy pkg drop omareel. It removes the package from your system.

What does omareel depend on?

The package declares 13 dependencies: ffmpeg, gpu-screen-recorder, hicolor-icon-theme, hyprland, layer-shell-qt, libevdev, libjpeg-turbo, qt6-base, qt6-declarative, qt6-multimedia, qt6-svg, slurp and more. Omarchy installs them for you.

Is omareel in the official Omarchy repo?

Yes. It is published as omareel (version 0.3.0-2) in the official Omarchy package repository. Omacom makes it. Project site: https://github.com/omacom/omareel.
